To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cell walls of C. utilis ATCC 9850 cultivated on agro-waste potato juice water with the addition of glycerol have the potential to be a mycotoxines binder.

Candida utilis ATTC 9950 cell wall preparation and β(1.3)/(1, 6)-glucans preparations isolated from Candidas utilis ATTC 9905 cultivated on waste potato water juice with glycerol can adsorb mycotoxines.
Candida utilis ATTC 9950 cell walls (CWs) and β( 1,3)/( 1,6)- glucan (β-Gs) preparations, produced from agro-waste, are potential feed additives to trap mycotoxicoses.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new feed additives with mycotoxin-binding properties, based on the yeast biomass, which can be obtained as a result of the fermentation of agro-waste.
the development of the new mycotoxines binders from agro-waste.
the development of new, effective, safe and low-cost adsorbents to reduce mycotoxigenic fungi and toxins in feed and food.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Candida utilis AT CC 9950 cell wall preparation has the potential to be used in animal feed as a mycotoxin binder.
CW and β-G from C. utilis ATCC 9850 cultivated on waste water from potato processing can be used as a potential adsorbent of mycotoxigenic fungi toxins in the feed industry.
the studied CW and β-G preparation could be used as feed additives to reduce the mycotoxin transfer to animals and their products.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of agro-waste as a substrate for the cultivation of yeast Candida utilis is a good way to reduce the negative impact of waste disposal and the production of valuable mycotoxin binder.
the waste potato juice could be a potential raw material for mycotoxines binders production.
the use of agro-wastes as a substrate in yeast cultivation for the purpose of obtaining mycotoxines adsorbents is an innovative and environmentally friendly approach.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Candida utilis ATC 9950 CW and β-G preparation could potentially be used in feed as an efficient binder of mycotoxines.
Candida utilis AT CC 9950 preparations can be used as feed additives for mycotox in control.
Candida utilis ATC C 9950 CW and β-G are able to adsorb mycotoxens, especially ZEN, OTA or AFB1.
